# commander Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Provider configuration for Commander Service Mode.
# See: https://docs.keeper.io/en/keeperpam/commander-cli/service-mode-rest-api

provider "commander" {
  service_mode_url     = "https://your-commander-service.example.com"
  service_mode_api_key = "your-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_mode_api_key` (String, Sensitive) The API key for the running Keeper Commander Service Mode, for more information see [Keeper Commander Service Mode](https://docs.keeper.io/en/keeperpam/commander-cli/service-mode-rest-api#keeper-commander-service-mode)
- `service_mode_url` (String) The URL of the running Keeper Commander Service Mode, for more information see [Keeper Commander Service Mode](https://docs.keeper.io/en/keeperpam/commander-cli/service-mode-rest-api#keeper-commander-service-mode)
